::: {.oneline}
An exciton is a pole of the electron–hole response function, not of the single-particle Green function. It sits below the quasiparticle gap because the electron–hole interaction binds the pair.
:::

## Short answer

*To write.* An exciton is a pole of the electron–hole response function, not of the single-particle Green function. It sits below the quasiparticle gap because the electron–hole interaction binds the pair.
